excluded_scope: Native-only routes retain existing method errors; this oracle covers only paths with a frozen Go registration.
URL clean-path/escaped-segment/subtree matching remains a separate acceptance scope; current Go 1.26.3 redirects clean paths with 307.
Authentication, store health and backend recovery ordering are tested at the gateway, not by this isolated mux oracle.
Marker handlers establish method selection, not card/API business behavior. HEAD still reaches a Go marker with Method HEAD; approved Rust aliases may dispatch GET internally.
